description: This file defines the HealthCheckEntity class, a JPA entity used to verify database connectivity and status within the monitoring system. It includes fields for ID, status, and timestamp, along with corresponding getters and constructors.

classes.name: HealthCheckEntity
classes.description: A JPA entity representing a health check record, used for database connectivity verification and system health monitoring.

methods.name: HealthCheckEntity
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity with a status message.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the autogenerated ID of the health check record.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status message of the health check.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status message of the health check.

methods.name: getCheckedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the health check was recorded.
